title: Somnath Temple, Gujarat | First of the 12 Jyotirlingas | Complete Guide
description: In this video I visit the Somnath Temple in Prabhas Patan, Gujarat — the first of the 12 Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. This temple has been rebuilt several times through history and sits right on the Arabian Sea coast. I cover the timings, the aarti schedule, and how to get there from Diu. #Jyotirlinga #Somnath #Gujarat
